description:
`dev/sessions/` holds three handoff and root-cause notes. Two name their issues; one has no identifier.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `dev/sessions/` does not exist.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each owned note lives in its owner's archive directory (terminal top epic) or `dev/active/` epic directory (open top epic) and is linked; the unowned note lives under `dev/archive/legacy/dev/sessions/`.
- [hard] REQ-03: The relative link from `dev/benchmarks/gf2_algebra_permanent/README.md` resolves to the note's new path.
- [hard] REQ-04: The manifest records each row as complete.
title: Empty dev/sessions into owner dirs or the legacy mirror
